SELECT gender, invoice_count, share, share - average_share AS share_above_average
FROM (
  SELECT gender, invoice_count, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS average_share
  FROM (
    SELECT gender, COUNT(*) AS invoice_count,
           CAST(COUNT(*) AS REAL) / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER () AS share
    FROM Invoices
    JOIN Orders USING (order_id)
    JOIN Customers USING (customer_id)
    GROUP BY gender
  )
)
WHERE share > average_share
